subject: Coordinating a 3-part security walkthrough (SOC 2 / Pen test / DPA) - proposed windows
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.inference>
To: Asha Patel <asha@greatfin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Coordinating a 3-part security walkthrough (SOC 2 / Pen test / DPA) - proposed windows

Hi Asha —

Thanks for the heads-up on GreatFin's intake. We'd like to get the SOC 2 overview, pen-test scoping, and DPA review scheduled so we can align attendees and circulating artifacts in advance. To keep this low-friction, two options we commonly run are:

- Option A: Single 90-minute session (SOC 2 overview 30m, pen-test scoping 45m, DPA Q&A 15m)
- Option B: Two short sessions across two days (SOC2 + DPA 45m; Pen-test deep-dive 60m)

Can you confirm which you prefer? If Option B is easier for scheduling, here are candidate windows in Eastern time (please tell us your preferred timezone if different):

- Tue May 28: 09:00–09:45 ET or 15:00–16:00 ET
- Wed May 29: 13:00–14:00 ET or 17:00–18:00 ET

We will bring: SOC 2 control map, evidence transfer options (Drive / SFTP), pen-test scoping checklist, and a draft mutual action plan. Attendees we suggest from our side: myself (solutions lead), Ben (security engineering), Jasmine (customer success).

Quick asks from you:
- Confirm preferred structure (single 90m vs split sessions)
- Preferred timezone and up to two candidate slots
- List of external attendees including legal if DPA redline is required

Attachments: redwood-soc2-playbook.pdf (summary), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft)

Thanks — happy to be flexible on timing.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.inference

From: Asha Patel <asha@greatfin.com>

Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@greatfin.com>, legal@greatfin.com
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 10:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating a 3-part security walkthrough (SOC 2 / Pen test / DPA) - proposed windows

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for laying this out. GreatFin would prefer Option B (split sessions). Legal will want to join the DPA portion and our security engineer (Tom Li) should be on the pen-test deep-dive. Week of May 28 mostly works but we have a blackout on May 28 from 11:00–16:00 ET for a product release.

Preferred approach:
- Day 1 (SOC2 + DPA): 45 minutes
- Day 2 (Pen test scoping): 60 minutes

Good candidate times in ET for us:
- Tue May 28: 09:00–09:45 ET (works before our blackout)
- Wed May 29: 13:00–14:00 ET (works)

We'd like evidence to be shared via a secure Drive link; please include details on retention and access controls. Also, legal will circulate a short redline to the DPA — can you confirm you’ll accept DocuSign or PDF redlines?

Attendees (tentative):
- Asha Patel (Security Lead, GreatFin)
- Tom Li (Security Engineer, GreatFin)
- Legal: legal@greatfin.com

Thanks — I can confirm final attendees after a quick internal check.

— Asha

Subject: Re: Coordinating a 3-part security walkthrough (SOC 2 / Pen test / DPA) - proposed windows

Hi Asha / Tom —

Appreciate the quick reply. Option B is perfect — below is a staggered plan we recommend (keeps focus and keeps each meeting to a clear agenda). I’ll own the pen-test scoping session; Jasmine will do the SOC 2 control map with you and Sergio will own the DPA Q&A.

Proposed schedule (all times ET):
- Session 1: Tue May 28, 09:00–09:45 ET — SOC 2 control map (30m) + DPA Q&A (15m)
  - Agenda bullets: high-level control families, evidence locations, retention/role access for Drive, DPA redline process
- Session 2: Wed May 29, 13:00–14:00 ET — Pen test scoping (60m)
  - Agenda bullets: target systems, test windows, vendor engagement model, success criteria, out-of-scope items

Evidence & artifacts:
- I've uploaded a scoped evidence folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSOC2Evidence (view+comment). We can provide SFTP if you prefer.
- Retention/access: Drive folder will be shared with explicit view/comment permissions; if you need short-lived links we can create them per-file.

DPA redline process:
- DocuSign link or PDF redline via email both work. If legal prefers tracked changes in Word we can accept that too. We’ll coordinate with our Legal Ops to respond within 3 business days to a redline submission.

Attachments sent with this message: dpa-redline-v1.pdf (our internal suggested starting point)

If those slots look good I’ll send calendar invites and include ICS with timezone normalization. Also please confirm the final attendee list for invite accuracy.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
